basis.publicValue: 005-A converts a real service workflow into explicit AUTOMATE / KEEP HUMAN / REMOVE candidates with visible reasons, while B-Web exposes the same separation visually.
basis.technologicalCeiling: The local deterministic classifier is intentionally inspectable. Automatic workflow mining, model classification, process-mining integrations and agentic automation are deferred because they would hide the decision rules this cycle exists to expose.
basis.evidenceProvenance: The classification rules are explicitly labeled product heuristics in data/build-005-engine-v1.json. Build 003's decision-gap engine is the only inherited scoring primitive and is imported directly.
basis.verificationEvaluation: Adversarial fixtures cover low-value repetition, high-judgment work, local export and interactive story state. The locator ambiguity found during certification was corrected semantically, and the final frozen candidate passed the complete Chromium/WebKit E2E matrix in GitHub Actions run 31928444353.
basis.browserFallback: Core value uses standard HTML/JS and deterministic local logic; no experimental browser AI or network/model feature is required.
basis.stateExportShare: Workflow state is visible in the step map and disposition lanes; explicit JSON export preserves signals, reasons and inherited decision-gap score; RESET / START OVER restores the demonstration workflow; no implicit share path exists.
basis.publicRecord: 005 is present in the shared public Making / Method / Evidence / Limits record.
basis.lineage: docs/infrastructure-manifest.json records exact Exhibition Room Shell reuse and direct decisionGapScore/decisionGapTier import from Build 003.
basis.metadata: 005-A and 005-B have distinct titles, descriptions, canonical routes, OpenGraph and Twitter metadata; the registry lifecycle exposes Build 005 as IN THE LAB.
basis.releaseEngineering: GitHub Actions run 31928444353 passed dependency installation, lineage validation, typecheck, lint, production build, Chromium/WebKit installation, and the complete Playwright E2E matrix on commit adaed223a9f649ed6ed79166339c7334071bdd0c.
